Hidden Legends

Released June 1, 2004 · 102 cards

Hidden Legends is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the EX series, released in English on June 1, 2004. Its main set has 101 cards, plus 1 secret rare numbered beyond the set (102 in total). It includes 93 Pokémon, 9 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.

Illustrators

21 illustrators worked on Hidden Legends. Most cards: Mitsuhiro Arita (10), Atsuko Nishida (8), Kagemaru Himeno (7), Ken Sugimori (7), Midori Harada (7), Hajime Kusajima (5), Hisao Nakamura (5), Ryo Ueda (5).
